text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!! Now just save this and 
enco—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nwa!? Why!? Whyyyy!? It froze...! My

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wait!! No, noooo!! Waaaah!! Move, 
dammit!!!!!"

On that day, Twin Turbo's anguished 
screams echoed throughout the entire 
dorm...
